facts.text: John participated in a community activity involving the fire-fighting brigade, which included loading a truck with a fire truck in the back.

evidence.quote: I was impressed with their dedication and how well they worked together. Just being around them was so inspiring!
That's amazing. Must have been awesome to see all those people working together.
It definitely was! Everyone was so into it. It's amazing how a group can succeed at something so important.

facts.text: John and others completed a task in two hours, which involved working hard and achieving a significant goal.

evidence.quote: It only took us two hours. We worked hard but did something good – it was really satisfying.

facts.text: John and others collected donations such as canned food, toiletries, and clothes during the activity.

evidence.quote: We raised a ton! We got stuff like canned food, toiletries, and clothes to help out.
